notes.title: Update Game
notes.content:
0.2 version includes:
1. Added new location Dangerous Dungeons
2. The camera has been redesigned. Now there will be no sharp jumps in the camera when restarting the level.
3. Fixed minor and critical bugs
4. Now the button hint is not in the Settings, but in the level itself when you press "F1"
5. Added a new achievement for the passage of the third location
6. Now, if you reach a new location with a small number of attempts, then it will automatically open to you.
7. Reduced the number of attempts to open new locations.
